source: 「古文譯本？我聽說不列顛王有一本，這是能讓人輕鬆閱讀盧恩文的魔法工具。」
translated: "An Ancient Text Translator? I've heard Britannia has one. It's a magical tool that makes reading Runes easy."

source: 「說實話，我平時幾乎沒有在使用這些古文了。現在只有在一些路標、建築銘版上會看到。」
translated: "To be honest, I rarely use those ancient texts anymore. Now I only see them on road signs and building plaques."

source: 「靠自己慢慢解讀其實有點累…，有了它，在不列顛尼亞的旅途肯定會方便許多。」
translated: "Deciphering things slowly on my own is a bit tiring... With this, traveling through Britannia will surely be much more convenient."

source: 「哇！古文譯本！這聽起來好厲害！我以前看那些招牌上的符號總覺得像是一堆奇怪的蟲子在爬。」
translated: "Wow! An Ancient Text Translator! That sounds amazing! I always felt like the symbols on those signs were just a bunch of strange bugs crawling around."

source: 「有了這個，我就能知道那些無聊的鎮民都在寫些什麼了！你下次用它的時候可以讓我也看看嗎？」
translated: "With this, I'll be able to see what those boring townsfolk are writing! Could you let me take a look at it the next time you use it?"

source: 「在荒野中生存，解讀古老的標記和盧恩文是必備的技能。」
translated: "Surviving in the wilderness requires the ability to interpret ancient markings and runes."

source: 「不過，既然你有了古文譯本，我想我們在探索那些古老遺跡時能省下不少時間。」
translated: "However, since you have the ancient text translation, I imagine we'll save quite a bit of time when exploring those ancient ruins."

source: 「希望它不會在我們最需要的時候失去魔力。」
translated: "I just hope it doesn't lose its magic at the most critical moment."

source: 「這些符文，原本是德魯依在使用的文字，所以每個符文都蘊藏自然的力量。」
translated: "These runes were originally the script used by Druids, so each rune holds the power of nature."

source: 「前人透過魔法陣，將為符文轉化為使用者能理解的方式，能幫助你看穿語言的迷霧，是個很好用的工具。」
translated: "The ancients used magic circles to translate the runes into a form understandable to users, helping you pierce through the fog of language; it is a very useful tool."

source: 「但現在大多遺失了！聽說不列顛王還有藏本，可跟他詢問看看。」
translated: "But most have been lost! I heard Britannia still has copies in his possession; you might ask him about them."

source: 「作為一名劍術教練，我一直告訴學生：了解敵人的意圖和揮劍一樣重要。」
translated: "As a sword instructor, I have always told my students: understanding your enemy's intent is just as important as swinging your sword."

source: 「這本寶典能讓你在不列顛尼亞的各個角落暢行無阻，掌握第一手情報。」
translated: "This tome will allow you to move freely throughout Britannia and gain firsthand intelligence."

source: 「知識，就像一把磨得鋒利的劍，永遠不嫌多！」
translated: "Knowledge is like a sharpened sword; one can never have too much of it!"

source: 「身為一名修補匠，我對各種精密的工具都有興趣。這本古文譯本就像是一把能夠拆解語言結構的萬能扳手！有了它，我們就不用在那些布滿灰塵的石碑前浪費時間瞎猜了，趕快去拿到手吧！」
translated: "As a tinkerer, I am interested in all sorts of precision tools. This ancient text translation is like a universal wrench that can dismantle the structure of language! With it, we won't have to waste time guessing blindly in front of dusty stone inscriptions. Go get it quickly!"

source: 「在 Magincia 放羊時，我偶爾會看到一些古老的遺跡，上面的文字總是讓我很好奇。」
translated: "While tending sheep in Magincia, I occasionally see some ancient ruins, and the writing on them always makes me curious."

source: 「有了這本寶典，我們就不用再像迷途的羔羊一樣，面對那些古文不知所措了。」
translated: "With this tome, we will no longer be like lost lambs, bewildered by ancient texts."

source: 「它一定能為我們的旅途帶來不少便利！」
translated: "It will surely bring much convenience to our journey!"

source: 「哼，友誼會的傢伙們總是滿口謊言，但那些刻在石頭上的古老盧恩文卻不會騙人。」
translated: "Hmph, the Brotherhood of Friendship is full of liars, but the ancient runes carved in stone do not deceive."

source: 「如果這本寶典能幫我們更快找到被隱藏的真相，或者揭露那些偽君子的陰謀，那它就是我們最好的武器。」
translated: "If this tome can help us uncover hidden truths faster, or expose the schemes of those hypocrites, then it is our best weapon."

source: 「讓我看看這玩意兒怎麼用。」
translated: "Let me see how this thing works."

source: 「哦？你說你遇到了一些看不懂的古文招牌？」不列顛王沉思了一會。
translated: "Oh? You say you encountered some ancient signs in a script you couldn't decipher?" The Britannian King pondered for a moment.

source: 「的確，那些是古老的不列顛盧恩符文。現在已經很少人使用了。」
translated: "Indeed, those are ancient Britannian runes. They are rarely used nowadays."

source: 「既然你需要，這本『古文譯本』就交給你吧，它能幫助你解讀那些古老的文字。」
translated: "Since you need it, I shall give you this 'Ancient Text Translator.' It will help you decipher those old writings."

source: 「你弄丟了我給你的那本『古文譯本』嗎？」不列顛王嘆了口氣。
translated: <PLACEHOLDER>Did you lose the 'Ancient Text Translation' I gave you?</PLACEHOLDER> The Britannian King sighed. "<PLACEHOLDER>Well, given your heavy burden, I'll give you another one. Don't lose it this time!</PLACEHOLDER>"

source: 「好吧，看在你身負重任的份上，我再給你一本。這次可別再弄丟了！」
translated: "<PLACEHOLDER>Well, given your heavy burden, I'll give you another one. Don't lose it this time!</PLACEHOLDER>"

source: 「這曾是座繁榮的城鎮——直到我毀了它！」他的下顎一緊，整張臉因痛苦而扭曲。
translated: "<PLACEHOLDER>This was once a prosperous town—until I destroyed it!</PLACEHOLDER>" His jaw tightened, his face contorted in pain.

source: 「為什麼？為什麼、為什麼、為什麼！」他再次因痛苦而劇烈抽息，但很快便按捺住情緒。
translated: "<PLACEHOLDER>Why? Why, why, why!</PLACEHOLDER>" He gasped again in agony, but quickly restrained his emotions.

source: 片刻之後，Meryl 登台，圍繞著 Dustin 的身軀跳舞，並在他身上灑下某種閃閃發光的粉末。
translated: A moment later, Meryl took the stage, dancing around Dustin's body and sprinkling some kind of glittering powder upon him.

source: 「盧恩古文～現在大概也只剩這些『復古風』的牌子在用了吧！」
translated: "Runic script... I suppose these 'retro-style' signs are about all that's left in use nowadays!"

source: 「平時沒在用…我都快看不懂了！」
translated: "I don't use it much anymore... I can barely read it myself!"

source: 「還記得怎麼讀嗎，聖者？」
translated: "Do you still remember how to read it, Avatar?"

source: 「真不負聖者之名！」
translated: "Truly worthy of the name of Sage!"

source: 「但如果有需要，我聽說不列顛王有一本『古文譯本』，可以快速翻譯出古文的意義！」
translated: "But if necessary, I've heard that the Britannian King possesses a 'Translation of Ancient Texts' that can quickly decipher the meaning of ancient scripts."

source: 「我想也是～不過，我聽說不列顛王有一本『古文譯本』，可以解決這個問題。」
translated: "I suppose so~ However, I've heard that the Britannian King has a 'Translation of Ancient Texts' that could solve this problem."

source: 「下次見到不列顛王時，可以跟他詢問看看。」
translated: "When you next see the Britannian King, you might ask him about it."

source: 「盧恩古文……現在還有人在用？」
translated: "Runic script... Is anyone still using it?"

source: 「嗯……有點難解讀……下次問問夥伴有無其他法子。」
translated: "Hmm... It's a bit difficult to decipher... I'll ask the party if there are other ways next time."
